takes notice for respondent Nos.1 and 2.
2. Heard both sides and perused the material on record.
3.

Appellants are arraigned as accused Nos.9 and 12 respectively in Crime No.27/2024 of Chamarajanagar NC: 2024:KHC:37936 town police station registered for offences punishable under Section 420, 465, 468 and 471 of IPC.

During investigation Section 120(B) of IPC and Section 3(1)(f)
of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 have been invoked.

sentences.text: 4. The learned Sessions Judge by an order dated 19.06.2024, has rejected the petitions filed by the appellants under Section 438 of Cr.P.C., hence, this appeal.
5. The complaint is lodged by one Sri. Mallikarjun. B., Deputy Director, District Social Welfare Department, Chamarajanagar.

6. The gist of the complaint is that Survey No.295 measuring 1 acre 22 guntas situated at Mrs Daicy D vs State Of Karnataka on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35434093/

sentences.text: Chamarajanagar was allotted by the Government to Adi Karnataka Abhivrudhi Sangha and is in the name of A.K.General Hostel.
The PWD has constructed a hostel in the said land in the year 1968.

However, all the accused have colluded with each other and forged the documents and by impersonation created sale deeds and sold 8 guntas each of the property in Survey No.295/4C, D and F respectively.

The learned High Court Government Pleader has contended that preliminary charge sheet is filed against four accused and investigation is under way against other accused named in the FIR as well as some more accused involved in the offence.
He contended that the appellants are required for custodial interrogation and therefore, not entitled for anticipatory bail.
8. The contention of the learned counsel for the appellants is that the appellants are bonafide purchasers and therefore, at this stage no criminal intention can be imputed against them.
It is also submitted that similarly placed other accused have been enlarged on bail by this Court.
9. The appellants are alleged to have purchased the property from the accused, who have impersonated the original owner.
they are said to be the bonafide purchasers.
Similarly placed accused No.8 has been enlarged on bail in Crl.A.No.1387/2024.

Appellants have NC:
2024:KHC:37936 undertaken to co-operate with the investigation and abide by other conditions.

Hence, the following:
ORDER i) Appeal is allowed.

ii) Order dated 19.06.2024 passed by the Court of Principal District and Sessions Judge, Chamarajanagar in so far as rejecting the application filed by these appellants/accused Nos.9 and 12, is hereby set aside.

entities.text: Court of Principal District and Sessions Judge, Chamarajanagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
iii) Appellants / accused Nos.9 and 12 (as per FIR) are ordered to be released in the event of their arrest in crime No.27/2024 of Chamarajanagar town police station,
subject to following conditions.

a) They shall appear before the Investigation Officer within a period of one week from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and shall execute a bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
 (Rupees One Lakh only) with two  sureties for the likesum.

d) They shall not tamper with the prosecution witnesses/evidence in any manner.
e) They shall appear before the Trial Court on every date of hearing, without fail.
